faq.a: Mehtap is associated with Persian. Mehtap is Persian مهتاب (mahtāb), meaning 'moonlight'. It is used as a female given name in Turkey.
No — the underlying form is Persian, not Arabic.
Mehtap can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Persian-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mehtap should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Mahtāb is a Persian word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.a: In Persian, Mehtap is rendered مهتاب and carries the sense مهتاب، مهتاب.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Mehtap, mehtap. Script forms are مهتاب, مَهْتَاب, مہتاب, मेहताब.

faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
